name: main-integration
body: The integration of a change-set into main: the single, gated act by which a project branch's work reaches the main checkout — `apg project merge <name>` (verify gate → merge → main rebuild → self-clean). No agent integrates by raw git (merge/checkout/switch/worktree add-remove on main); the coordinator's only branch-state git mutation is rebasing the project worktree onto main, run inside the worktree.
